data.body: Landed and closed. Change: https://rebar.solutions.navateam.com/c/rebar/+/1035 (merged as 517e0470a, LLM-Review +1, Verified +1). What landed: new src/rebar/llm/plan_review/reuse.py holding both reuse short-circuits — the existing PASS idempotent_reuse (moved verbatim; __init__.py was at 799/800 LOC) and the new verdict_reuse, which reuses a stored BLOCK from sidecar.latest_review_result when material_fingerprint AND verified_at_sha match current and --force is absent: zero LLM calls, coverage.llm_ran=False + coverage.verdict_reuse=True, no new sidecar, exit 1 preserved. CLI renders a 'reused: stored BLOCK verdict is still current' marker. Tests: tests/unit/test_plan_review_reuse.py (7 tests: zero-LLM reuse, exit 1 + marker rendering, --force bypass, plan-change and code-change invalidation); existing gate/idempotence suites pass unmodified.
